title: Protein Intake Calculator
description: Find your optimal daily protein target in grams from body weight and activity level, with per-meal splits.
howto: Enter your body weight in kg or lb.
Pick the activity level that matches your lifestyle.
Read your daily protein target and how to split it across meals.

faqs.q: Why is protein measured per kg of body weight?
faqs.a: Research-backed ranges (1.2-2.2 g/kg for active people, 0.8 g/kg minimum for sedentary adults) scale with body size, so heavier people need more.

faqs.q: Can I eat too much protein?
faqs.a: Healthy kidneys handle high intakes well, but there is little benefit above ~2.2 g/kg for muscle building. Spread intake across 3-5 meals for best use.
All dietary protein: meat, fish, eggs, dairy, legumes, tofu, nuts and protein powders.
